exact_edit_path: Embed the package-portable PowerShell/.NET PInvoke bridge in src/platform/windows/job-object.ts. Extend the internal spawn seam so Windows launches with CREATE_SUSPENDED, creates/configures a kill-on-close Job, assigns the process before ResumeThread, verifies the process handle creation identity, and returns an opaque bridge token. Track bounded framed stdout/stderr and helper exit state in tracked-process.ts. SessionManager must consume the pre-bound attachment and never reopen custody by PID. windows/process.ts must default to the Job backend and report unavailable when probing fails; windows_validated_tree remains diagnostic-only and cannot be supported.
scope_assessment: The contract-owned scope is sufficient if the helper is embedded in job-object.ts and uses only Windows PowerShell/.NET platform APIs. Add-Type compiles only the managed PInvoke wrapper at helper startup; no downloaded or external native dependency is required. Linux custody remains unchanged.
risks: PowerShell/.NET availability or policy restrictions must fail closed as unavailable.
CreateProcessW command-line quoting, environment blocks, redirected stdio, and bounded multiplexed framing require strict tests.
Graceful termination must use verified handle-bound window/control signaling, then bounded TerminateJobObject escalation; no taskkill or raw PID authority.
Helper EOF must close every Job handle, and normal release must leave no helper process.
Windows Job custody cannot be safely reattached by PID after controller loss; recovery must preserve ambiguity and only remove leases after absence/postconditions are proven.
